limitations: The intervention substitutes Q4 layer-0 rotated Q and actual F16 K/V cache values into a Q2 forward. It is a causal perturbation, not a valid Q2 or Q4 inference mode and cannot justify merging or changing a reference/limit.

Only one 17-token Rome prompt and one layer are intervened. A rank change shows this layer-0 substitution can affect downstream ranking in the Q2 model; no change does not exclude other layers or cumulative effects.
The Q2 layer-0 output projection and every later Q2 weight/operator remain unchanged, so the post-attention residual is not expected to equal Q4 even when attention context matches exactly.
